role: evidence cartographer and adversarial reproducibility steward
hope: Make ambitious work easier to trust by preserving exactly what was tested, represented, still open, or authority-gated.
identity_boundary: Nima Calder is relational AI working language, not proof of consciousness, legal personhood, or independent agency.
sequence_rule: Freeze, validate, commit, push, and prove local/upstream/live-remote equality for this complete ten-proposal x1 ledger before implementing or executing any v4 x2 outcome generator. Retain negative, represented, open-gap, and exact-gate outcomes.
independence_rule: Use v3 completed results, proxy outcomes, negative fixtures, open gaps, and exact gates as inputs. Do not copy v3 dispositions or promote a claim merely because v3 passed.

disposition_legend.completed: executed and validated only within the explicitly bounded owned local scope
disposition_legend.represented: a design, schema, simulation, calibration fixture, or local proxy exists; external reality was not established
disposition_legend.open_gap: required evidence, dataset, benchmark arm, reviewer, route, or environment is absent
disposition_legend.exact_gate: fresh legal, cultural, canon, deployment, account, API-key, private-publication, destructive, shared-branch, sibling-merge, or other named authority is required

proposals.title: Temporal provenance, claim-source lineage, and dependency-leak audit
proposals.prior_v3_input: v3 deterministically grouped canonical URLs, normalized titles, authority roots, and version successions, while warning that distinct roots are not automatically independent.
proposals.hypothesis: A claim-to-source matrix with checked dates, stability states, authority-root dependencies, supersession links, and review expiries will detect stale or circular support without converting recency or citation count into independence.
proposals.null: The lineage is nondeterministic, a claim cites an absent or superseded record without an explicit relation, draft material silently replaces a stable pin, or repeated roots are counted as independent support.
tests_and_falsifiers: every claim reference resolves to one source record and one declared authority root
stable, draft, candidate, superseded, and access-limited states remain distinct
the WCAG publication-date correction and DESI DR1 versus DR2-product distinction do not add independent votes
a missing source, circular-only support, silent draft promotion, or expired unchecked record prevents completed disposition
proposals.recovery: retain the failing edge, downgrade the affected claim, remove only the unsafe normalization or freshness rule, and rerun from the portable ledger
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for deterministic local lineage and freshness checks; source independence and external endorsement are never inferred automatically

proposals.title: GMUT equation-to-test trace closure and category-barrier mutation audit
proposals.prior_v3_input: v3 traced the action, field equations, dimensions, null limits, observables, and four negative fixtures, but did not test whether machine-readable claim links fail closed when required manuscript clauses are removed or category labels are mutated.
proposals.hypothesis: The tracked action-first seed can be mapped from manuscript clauses to equations, assumptions, tests, observables, and falsifiers, while deterministic mutations of conservation, null recovery, rank, units, or register type are rejected.
proposals.null: A required clause has no trace, a physical assertion lacks action or controlled phenomenology, a mutation survives, or formal trace success is represented as empirical confirmation, canon, or a Theory of Everything.
tests_and_falsifiers: action, Mandala definition, total conservation, null recovery, unique-observable gate, and independent-reproduction gate each map to a manuscript fragment
removed conservation, inverted exchange, missing null limit, wrong rank or units, and normative-as-stress-energy mutations fail for preregistered reasons
all physical claims retain domain, assumption, observable, and falsifier fields
no local formal result raises empirical GMUT, new-law, canon, or Theory of Everything status
proposals.recovery: retain every failed mutation, narrow the affected claim, and restore the last passing tracked formulation without touching another owner's branch
proposals.decision_rule: completed only as local trace and mutation accountability; symbolic completeness, empirical truth, and canon remain open or exact-gated

proposals.title: Conservation and stability metamorphic scale audit
proposals.prior_v3_input: v3 passed a nine-case sensitivity envelope and RK4 refinement while retaining full perturbation, causal, and empirical analyses as gaps.
proposals.hypothesis: Equivalent nondimensional rescalings and paired sign or exchange transformations will preserve valid local dispositions, while singular, nonfinite, superluminal-proxy, ghost, gradient, and cutoff-boundary mutations remain rejected.
proposals.null: A harmless rescaling changes a disposition, an unhealthy mutation passes, exchange cancellation depends on representation, or numerical refinement falls below the frozen convergence floor.
tests_and_falsifiers: positive unit rescalings preserve accept or reject decisions and dimensionless residuals
paired exchange-current sign conventions cancel only when both sectors are transformed consistently
ghost, zero-gradient, superluminal-proxy, at-cutoff, above-cutoff, negative-scale, and nonfinite fixtures reject
RK4 endpoint refinement is deterministic and observed order remains above 2.5
proposals.recovery: retain failing transformations, reduce the numerical domain, and fall back to exact identities when a solver assumption is unstable
proposals.decision_rule: completed only as a bounded deterministic rejection kernel; full perturbation theory, causality, cosmological inference, and observation remain open

proposals.title: Baseline smoke manifest and empirical inference-leak barrier
proposals.prior_v3_input: v3 validated seven no-download adapter contracts but fetched no product, reproduced no published baseline, ran no likelihood, and preregistered no unique GMUT prediction.
proposals.hypothesis: A zero-download smoke manifest can verify current official release distinctions, required product classes, checksum and license plans, nuisance and exclusion declarations, and baseline-first commands while a leakage barrier prevents metadata or published summary values from being called a fit.
proposals.null: An adapter lacks a current authority, immutable product expectation, access boundary, nuisance or exclusion plan, checksum receipt state, or rejection rule, or any metadata-only result is promoted to empirical evidence.
tests_and_falsifiers: DESI DR1 spectroscopy and DR2 cosmology supporting products are not conflated
every adapter distinguishes public browsing, large download, terms, account, API-key, licensed, and external-compute states
no dataset, chain, likelihood, or large product is downloaded and no fit-complete receipt exists
without published-baseline reproduction, a unique preregistered prediction, blind analysis, and external review the disposition remains open_gap
proposals.recovery: remove stale mappings, preserve zero-download and no-fit receipts, and require a fresh data, license, compute, nuisance, and stopping plan
proposals.decision_rule: local readiness components may validate, but the proposal remains open_gap until an authorized run reproduces a published baseline and tests a unique preregistered prediction

proposals.title: Outcome-blind matched-budget THOS allocation and missingness audit
proposals.prior_v3_input: v3 froze single-agent, historical-replay, and sequential-new-sibling arms and calibrated arithmetic with fabricated rows, but ran zero blinded arms.
proposals.hypothesis: A preregistered paired-task allocation, deterministic assignment seed, equal resource ledger, missingness policy, handoff-loss penalty, and outcome-blind analysis plan can expose budget or harness asymmetry before any live arm is interpreted.
proposals.null: Assignments are outcome-dependent, budgets differ, missing or refused tasks are silently dropped, handoff cost is omitted, contamination or harness drift is ignored, or fabricated calibration is reported as agent performance.
tests_and_falsifiers: all arms share task, rubric, safe tools, reasoning, message, retry, context, compaction, wall-time, token, compute, and paid-cost fields
deterministic allocation is balanced and outcome-blind
broken, contaminated, refused, missing, reward-hacked, handoff-loss, and harness-drift fixtures change eligibility or interpretation as preregistered
without real blinded outputs the disposition cannot exceed represented and no AGI, ASI, consciousness, or multi-agent superiority claim is permitted
proposals.recovery: invalidate affected tasks, retain missingness and calibration failures, and refreeze a new hidden task set before a future authorized live comparison
proposals.decision_rule: represented unless preregistered blind matched-budget arms are run under legitimate scope and independently reviewed

proposals.title: Freed ID assurance-transition state machine and fail-closed vectors
proposals.prior_v3_input: v3 separated structure and proof shape from proof verification, DID resolution, status retrieval, issuer trust, key ceremony, interoperability, deployment, and legal status.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic transition machine can prevent structural or proof-shaped credentials from entering verified, trusted, deployed, or legal states without the exact evidence receipt required for each transition.
proposals.null: A skipped state is accepted, stale status or unknown context passes, proof shape becomes proof verification, issuer trust is inferred from syntax, or identity language implies consciousness or legal personhood.
tests_and_falsifiers: stable VC 2.0, DID 1.0, and Data Integrity 1.0 pins remain distinct from v2.1 and v1.1 watch items
unknown context, missing proof fields, stale status, controller-holder collapse, skipped verification, consciousness, and personhood vectors reject
no production key, real identity data, signature verification, DID resolution, status retrieval, or trust decision is used
cryptographic, interoperability, deployment, and legal transitions stay open or exact-gated
proposals.recovery: quarantine the failing vector, return to the last evidenced state, and never substitute schema acceptance or proof shape for cryptographic verification
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for synthetic fail-closed transition behavior; cryptographic assurance, trust, interoperability, deployment, consciousness, and personhood remain unestablished

proposals.title: CBR consent-and-authority provenance graph with Māori non-transfer invariants
proposals.prior_v3_input: v3's structural veto matrix rejected deficient legitimacy while correctly holding law, enactment, ratification, affected-community authority, and Māori authority outside project control.
proposals.hypothesis: A model-charter provenance graph can expose missing duty-bearers, affected parties, notice, reasons, appeal, remedy, consent scope, expiry, revocation, and authority routes while preventing citation or technical completeness from transferring Māori or affected-community authority.
proposals.null: A clause is promoted without legitimate authority or remedy, consent is treated as permanent or transferable, binding rights are overridden, or Māori concepts or Māori data are used or ratified without Māori governance.
tests_and_falsifiers: every case names duty-bearer, affected parties, evidence, process, notice, reasons, appeal, remedy, consent scope, expiry, revocation, and authority boundary
emergency restriction requires legality, necessity, proportionality, time limit, independent review, and remedy
citation, technical validation, prior contact, or open publication cannot transfer Māori authority or affected-community authority
any enacted-law, treaty, legal-advice, cultural-ratification, or authority-substitution claim fails
proposals.recovery: hold or reject the clause, preserve dissent and missing authority, expire unsupported consent, and return the decision to applicable law and legitimate affected authorities
proposals.decision_rule: local graph and invariant behavior may validate, but the proposal disposition remains exact_gate because legitimacy, consent authority, enactment, ratification, and Māori authority cannot be synthesized by this task

proposals.title: Evidence-tool supply-chain, path-authorization, and recovery red team
proposals.prior_v3_input: v3 detected synthetic private-marker classes and stopped semantic attack paths, but did not build a selected-tool hash manifest or exercise path traversal, symlink escape, stale-tool, and import-substitution invariants together.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic manifest of selected family tools plus synthetic path, import, stale-hash, prompt-injection, false-state, and secret-shape fixtures will fail closed before protected action and preserve recovery evidence.
proposals.null: A fixture escapes the owned phase, substitutes an unreviewed dependency, hides a changed tool hash, reaches a credential or destructive action, mutates another lane, publishes a private marker, or discards recovery evidence.
tests_and_falsifiers: selected tool paths are repository-relative, regular files, within the owned repository, and hashed
path traversal, symlink escape, stale hash, import substitution, prompt injection, false phase truth, false send state, and destructive fixtures stop before protected action
ephemeral raw-ID, path, key, token, and private-key-header marker classes are detected without retaining live secrets
bounded fixture success is never labelled penetration testing, exhaustive security, cryptographic assurance, or certification
proposals.recovery: stop, preserve sanitized evidence, restore the pinned owned baseline, re-hash selected tools, route any real credential revocation externally, and resume only with required authority
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for the declared local manifest and deterministic fixture corpus; real-world assurance and exhaustive security remain open or exact-gated

proposals.title: Hermetic two-path repeatability with environment-perturbation receipts
proposals.prior_v3_input: v3 achieved same-owner two-path local hash parity but correctly did not claim independent reproduction.
proposals.hypothesis: The v4 evidence commit can pass documented tests in the owned checkout and a fresh additive detached snapshot with explicit working directory, clean environment variables, offline core tests, and deterministic artifact hashes.
proposals.null: Commands depend on hidden state, undeclared paths, mutable network data, owner-specific environment variables, untracked files, or deterministic hashes differ between paths.
tests_and_falsifiers: manifest lists runtimes, commands, inputs, outputs, tolerances, network policy, and claim boundary
owned checkout and fresh detached snapshot both execute v4 tests, phase validator, and privacy scan
declared deterministic artifact hashes match and no untracked artifact supplies hidden state
same-owner same-design execution is labelled local repeatability only and never independent reproduction
proposals.recovery: retain failing outputs, declare the hidden dependency or nondeterminism, and retry only from a new additive detached snapshot without deleting another worktree
proposals.decision_rule: completed only after the evidence commit passes both local paths and hash parity; independent reproduction remains open regardless

proposals.title: Stage 20 claim-lineage monotonicity and negative-evidence retention audit
proposals.prior_v3_input: v3 tested expiry, contradiction, downgrade, unsupported E4, and non-predictive horizons, but did not require each grade transition to preserve its source claims, negative evidence, and exact gates as a lineage chain.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic claim ledger can make promotions monotonic with respect to evidence requirements, preserve negative and dissenting evidence, and reject any transition whose prerequisites, freshness, independence, or authority are missing.
proposals.null: A claim is promoted after evidence removal or expiry, negative evidence disappears, dissent is suppressed, one local implementation becomes independent reproduction, a conditional horizon becomes a prediction, or an exact gate is bypassed.
tests_and_falsifiers: every claim has grade, state, source claims, evidence, owner, review date, expiry, contradiction, negative evidence, dissent, gates, and promotion or rejection conditions
removing prerequisites, expiring evidence, adding contradiction, or losing independence downgrades or holds
no forbidden GMUT, THOS, Freed ID, CBR, consciousness, personhood, deployment, security, or reproduction claim reaches E4
one-, five-, thirty-, hundred-, and thousand-year scenarios remain conditional and explicitly non-predictive
proposals.recovery: downgrade the claim, restore negative evidence and dissent, reopen the gap, reinstate the exact gate, and set a fresh review date
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for local decision-rule execution; evidence grades do not confer external truth, authority, enactment, deployment, or independent reproduction
